about: Saint-Rémi is a city in the Jardins-de-Napierville MRC of Montérégie, Quebec, southwest of Montréal in rich vegetable country. A compact agricultural service centre, it sits among market-garden fields rather than on the Island of Montréal. About 9,000 people live in Saint-Rémi.
seoSummary: Montérégie market-garden city southwest of Montréal—Jardins-de-Napierville agricultural service centre.
